properties.title: Datacurve

overview_description.description:
DataCurve  aims to provide a multi-lingual online B2B global directory of business contacts and company information. Its unique model combines three disparate approaches crowd sourcing, online vertical search/mash-up and offline data aggregation.

DataCurve incentive-based crowd-sourcing model allow members to add their contact lists to its library. In return they will be entitled to get Credits which can be either used as commissions on all future sales (as long as they keep the data current) or can be used to get other business contacts.
